categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production, processing, and sales of polyethylene plastics including ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVA) resins, plastic products, cyclic block copolymers (CBC), catalysts and related chemicals, plastic processing equipment, vinyl chloride monomer (VCM), PVC powder and products, chemical products, glass wool, printing products, ferrite powders and cores, and silicon carbide powders. It also engages in investment, general import-export trade, and energy supply. The business segments include plastics raw materials, electronic materials, and other related products, with plastics raw materials accounting for 92% of revenue.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes polymerization processes for producing LDPE, EVA, HDPE, LLDPE, ABS, SAN, GPS, and EPS resins, employing high-pressure and low-pressure reactors with catalysts such as organic peroxides and transition metal catalysts. It has proprietary NOVA process technology for GPS production with low residual monomer. The company also develops advanced materials like high VA EVA, optical-grade CBC, and high-purity SiC powders. Production involves polymerization, pelletizing, extrusion, and finishing processes, with ongoing equipment upgrades and AI integration for process optimization and energy efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream plastic product manufacturers, electronics and semiconductor industries, automotive and transportation sectors, construction and building materials markets, and international brand clients in solar energy, packaging, and medical applications. The company serves domestic and international markets, with significant exports to China, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, Africa, Americas, and Oceania. Major end markets include packaging, footwear, electrical cables, automotive components, consumer electronics, and industrial insulation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung, Lin Yuan, and other locations, and has subsidiaries and sales offices in Mainland China, Malaysia, and other Asian countries. Export markets include China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, Africa, North and South America, and Oceania. The company actively expands sales outside China and Hong Kong to diversify market risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the petrochemical and plastics supply chain, producing polymer resins and intermediate chemical products such as VCM and EDC. It also engages in downstream processing of plastics into finished products like PVC pipes, films, and plastic sheets. The company maintains upstream raw material supply contracts with major suppliers like Taiwan CPC and invests in storage and logistics infrastructure to secure feedstock supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value and differentiated EVA products, expanding applications in solar encapsulation, footwear, and cables, and advancing environmentally friendly and recycled materials with ISO14021 certification. R&D focuses on optical-grade CBC materials for electronics and medical uses, high-performance ABS and EPS products, and silicon carbide ceramics for power electronics and electric vehicles. The company invests in AI and digitalization to optimize production and energy efficiency, and pursues ESG and sustainability goals including carbon neutrality by 2050.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical and plastic products including polymer resins (PE, EVA, PVC, ABS, PS), electronic materials, and related downstream products. The company also earns income from investment holdings and energy supply. Sales are conducted via direct sales to industrial customers and distributors, with pricing influenced by market conditions and long-term supply contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major regional petrochemical producers from China, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, and other Asian countries. It holds a significant market share in Taiwan and maintains competitive advantages through product differentiation, vertical integration, and strong customer relationships. The company faces intense price competition due to overcapacity in China and global market volatility but mitigates risks by focusing on high-value products and expanding into emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$51 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a net loss attributable to owners of about NT$2.15 billion. Total assets are around NT$71.8 billion with equity of NT$42.8 billion. The company experienced a decline in revenue and profitability due to lower product prices and market demand. Capital expenditures include investments in ethylene storage and infrastructure to secure raw material supply. The company maintains stable operations with ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and expand markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, technological innovation, and sustainability as key differentiators. It offers high-value EVA products tailored for solar energy, footwear, and cable applications, and proprietary NOVA process GPS with low residual monomer. The company integrates ESG principles by developing recycled and low-carbon footprint materials, achieving certifications like GRS and ISO standards. Strong customer service, technical support, and global marketing networks enhance its competitive positioning, enabling it to serve diverse markets with differentiated and environmentally friendly products.
